description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Redcap Gutter-Dweller, adding {C}{C}.
When Redcap Gutter-Dweller dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Redcap Gutter-Dweller from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Redcap Gutter-Dweller enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
